layoutNote: layoutVersion is the bucket-layout generation the pack stage copies into manifest.layoutVersion (PIPELINE 15.2, CONTRACT 8.4). Increment it in the same commit as any change that re-keys a bucket id: a family's B or G, the opt-in sizing below, the family set, the host-hash function, or the public-suffix subset in src/lib/psl-data.mjs. minAppBuild is the lowest Janus build allowed to install a bundle built from this layout; raise it only when a bundle stops being readable by an older app.
note: B and G are provisional until the first CI run reports real converted counts, and are then set from build/validate/<flavour>/report.json (DESIGN 1.3). Raising B re-keys a whole family and forces a full re-download, so it may only change in a commit that also bumps manifest.layoutVersion (PIPELINE 10.3).
optInNote: Every default:false list needs an entry, or the bucket stage falls back to B=1,G=1 with an optin-unsized warning. B and G here size only the list's own network group; its cos.generic/cos.specific groups take the family numbers. These six are all under 80k rules each, so B=1 (adguard.tracking B=2 at 79k) keeps every opt-in bucket well inside the soft cap. Changing a B here re-keys that list's bucket ids and needs a layoutVersion bump.
